question: Which chemical compound is used in car batteries and has the formula PbSO₄?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lead sulfate**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lead sulfate** (PbSO4) is the chemical compound used in car batteries.
